reportA_mechanism.title: How Jarvis performs a console step today
reportA_mechanism.lineNumbersNote: Thunai.tsx references are to the committed version at HEAD 0a4b0245 (3136 lines). The working copy of Thunai.tsx was being edited by another session during this walk (its runStep had moved from line 693 to 701 by 15:38), so re-anchor by the function names given. CollectorApp.tsx, dom.ts and lib/thunai/{types,risk,reach,rules,understand,plan,lexicon,stagelocal,skeleton}.ts were unmodified.
pipeline: 1. A sentence (heard by the conductor, typed in the HUD, or pushed by an event) reaches handle() (Thunai.tsx:1619-1945). In order: a running mission's own words (1627-1650: start, stop, skip that, instead X, without N); the v8 news lane and Stage references by position or place (1723-1750); newsAsk (1751-1761); the open Stage's local commands (1762-1774: lib/thunai/stagelocal.ts:46 localStageCommand -> applyLocal); the v4 flows remember/forget/recall/what-today/brief/follow/mission (1775-1805); then the rules: understand() (lib/thunai/understand.ts) returns {kind:'do', steps, confidence} | ask | refuse | unknown (1808-1810).

2. Data Studio intercept: with a dataset open on the Data Studio page, every sentence that is not a page move or an instant reflex goes to the dataset's own engine instead of the console (Thunai.tsx:1811-1819 -> askDataset 2373-2397). Reflexes are stop, off, undo, confirm, repeat, handsfree, speed, numbers, and click-by-number while numbers show (lib/thunai/plan.ts:468-471 isReflex); 'click <name>', 'type', 'scroll', filters and panels do not get through there.

3. Instant paths: reflexes run at once (1821-1825); a plain move or a nav command the rules are >= 0.9 sure of runs at once with no model (1828-1833; lib/thunai/plan.ts:436-465 isPlainMove/isNavCommand). Otherwise the agent is asked (1865 callAgent -> /api/collector/thunai/agent): it returns a Stage screen (recipes, lib/thunai/screens.ts), console steps, or a Stage op (1868-1900); failing that the v1 planner (1903-1918, think -> /api/collector/thunai/plan, every step checked by lib/thunai/plan.ts:407 checkPlan against AI_ACTIONS plan.ts:24-27, with isDangerButton on clicks), then the rules' own plan or the analyst (1919-1944).

4. Risk gates before running: level A runs with an undo; level B (workspace save, remember, forget, remind, Stage pin/save) waits for a spoken yes or a tap (gateB Thunai.tsx:961-978, the yes check 1695-1704, never from browser captions); level C (draft, send, rain mission) only fills the approval tray and needs Jarvis's name or an engaged turn (needsName 1711-1717); sending is only the tray's Approve tap (step confirm answers 'yours to tap', 832-833; confirmGate lib/thunai/risk.ts:42-48). Levels: lib/thunai/risk.ts:11-26, mirrored in lib/thunai/reach.ts:35-39 ACTION_LEVEL.

5. run() (Thunai.tsx:847-912): pushes an undo snapshot for view-changing steps (host.snapshot, VIEW_CHANGING 846, max 20), closes Jarvis's Stage before any dashboard move (NAVIGATES 845, 859-863), shows step chips, glides the ghost pointer to the control (glide 565-581 using dom.ts:75-106 targetFor), then calls runStep(step) (693-840) for each step, then audits (/api/collector/thunai/audit) and says what it did (lib/thunai/afterplan.ts).

bridge.what: Mostly React state setters through a bridge, not DOM clicks.
bridge.host: ThunaiHost (Thunai.tsx:95-125), built in CollectorApp.tsx:742-762: c (the Console object CollectorApp.tsx:102-211, values 612-689: setPage, setPeriod, setZone, setDept, setTaluk, setCat, setSevTab, setMapMode, toggleLayer, setEnvSel, openInc, openAction, openList, openNewsAll, openStories, openGaps, openNextDoor, openMarkets, openZones, openDepts, openFeeds, openReview, openWorkspace, saveWorkspace, openSavedWorkspace, openConflict, askOnMap, mapAsk, closeAll, setAsk, locate, …), plus ov/ins data, applyView (several filters in one transaction), snapshot/restore (undo), toggleTheme, openExport, openCustomize, openPalette, askWith (declared, unused by Jarvis), settled() (waits up to 4 s for the console's loading, CollectorApp.tsx:747-748), and dev URLs.

domPath.what: The generic fallback for anything without a step: DOM clicks by accessible name or number.
domPath.find: dom.ts:40-55 clickables(): every visible element matching dom.ts:11 CLICKABLE (button, a[href], input, select, textarea, summary, [role=button|tab|link|menuitem|checkbox|switch], [tabindex]), skipping disabled, hidden, off-screen, covered by a scrim (visible() 13-23 uses elementFromPoint) and Jarvis's own UI ([data-thunai-ui], dom.ts:10, 44); sorted top-to-bottom, left-to-right; capped at 99.
domPath.name: dom.ts:25-35 accessibleName(): aria-label | title | placeholder | aria-labelledby, joined with the visible text; byName() dom.ts:58-67 scores exact > startsWith > includes, shortest name wins. Label elements' text is not read, so inputs named only by a <label> (e.g. Take action's Subject) have no name.
domPath.press: dom.ts:69-72 press(): el.click(); for input/textarea/select it only focuses (so selects cannot choose an option and checkboxes cannot be ticked).
domPath.guards: Thunai.tsx:805-810: [data-jarvis-never] or isDangerButton (lib/thunai/skeleton.ts:26-27: send|approve|confirm|delete|remove|discard|reject|submit|verify|close it|work is done|accept + Tamil, on a look-alike-folded skeleton) -> refused; keepsSomething (thunai/guards.ts:9-15: save|pin|unpin|bookmark|keep|add…dashboard|bare Yes/OK) -> refused (level B needs the spoken 'save this' path).
domPath.other: scroll (dom.ts:109-122: the panel in front, else the largest scrollable area); typeInto (dom.ts:125-134: the focused input or textarea via the native value setter + an input event, so React sees it; never a password or /pass|otp|pin/ field); readChart (dom.ts:137-156: ECharts option of the nearest chart, for 'explain this chart'); spotlight (dom.ts:159-166); targetFor (dom.ts:75-106) only aims the ghost pointer and several of its selectors are stale (.theme-t, [aria-label="Export report"], [aria-label="Workspaces"], [aria-label="Customize"], .sevtab: no element has them), so those steps only pulse the orb.

reportA_mechanism.stage: Jarvis's own Stage (full-screen answers) is driven by Stage ops, not the console: localStageCommand (lib/thunai/stagelocal.ts:22-34 LocalCmd: filter, sort, view, next, prev, stop, read, again, close, back, clear, pin, export, open, draft, map, full, everywhere) and the agent's stageOp (Thunai.tsx:1543-1564 applyStageOp) -> stageReducer (pure, tested in reach.test.ts) -> runEffect (1482-1507), whose effects can touch the console (mapItem -> c.askOnMap, rebuild with clearConsole -> applyView, draft -> the tray).
reportA_mechanism.map: The Leaflet map is never driven directly: SatMap registers itself with thunai/mapbridge.tsx (SatMap.tsx:133 setConsoleMap) only so the reticle can read screen positions. Map moves go through filters (view step, which flies the map), c.locate, or Ask the Map (askOnMap / mapAsk.run / mapAsk.draw).
reuseForNewVoicePaths: A control backed by console state: add a setter to Console (CollectorApp.tsx:102-211 type, 612-689 values) or to ThunaiHost (742-762); add a Step kind (lib/thunai/types.ts:24-65), its level in lib/thunai/risk.ts:11-18 and lib/thunai/reach.ts:35-39 (reach.test.ts fails if they disagree) plus a REACH row with an example sentence (reach.test.ts checks it is understood); words in lib/thunai/lexicon.ts and lib/thunai/understand.ts; a case in runStep (Thunai.tsx:693-840); membership in ACTS_ON_PAGE / NAVIGATES / VIEW_CHANGING (843-846) for undo and Stage behaviour; in AI_ACTIONS and checkPlan (lib/thunai/plan.ts:24-27, 407) so the planner may choose it; in MOVES/NAV_STEPS (plan.ts:436, 448) if it should run instantly; a targetFor selector (dom.ts:75-106) for the pointer.

A control whose state lives inside a component (card tabs, sort orders, pickers, Rain & flooding's tabs, Ask the Map's tools, Data Studio's tabs): lift the state to Console, or listen for a window CustomEvent inside the component (the pattern of studio/Dataset.tsx:114-117 diq:studio-spot or rehearsal/RainBand.tsx:27-28 diq:rehearsal) and dispatch it from a new step.

Make generic clicks dependable meanwhile: give icon-only buttons and label-only inputs an aria-label, give clickable <tr>/<li>/<th>/<h2> a role and tabindex (or a button), and mark irreversible controls with data-jarvis-never (the Attention.test.ts pattern).
Keep the existing safety shape: Jarvis never sends, approves or deletes; anything that keeps something is level B; anything outward fills the tray only.

reportB_tests.title: Existing tests that check controls against Jarvis's reach

asserts: every ActionName in ACTION_LEVEL has the level risk.ts riskOf runs ('read' counts as A)
what fills the tray is level C (draft, mission rain), the brief only reads (mission brief A); the REACH rows for heavy rain and Draft are C; planRisk/tapRisk of item+draft, draft+remember, send

every REACH row's example sentence reaches something: 'never' rows are refused by routeByRules; the others give a do-plan with steps from understand(), or a quickScreen recipe, or the router's district lane
"Save this workspace as Collector's Daily Briefing" is a level-B workspace save with that name
"pin this to the Overview" (and Tanglish and Tamil forms) is localStageCommand {op:'pin'}
cannotLine and NO_MODEL_LINE wording; agentPrompt exists
stageReducer: filter and sort change only the model; a filter that matches nothing changes nothing; open/next/draft/everywhere are effects; back and close; the digest is small and current
tests.scope: Checks the 20-row REACH table of capabilities and the risk table, not the console's controls: it never reads a component file or the DOM, so a new or renamed button is not caught.

asserts: the Verify button (Attention.tsx) carries data-jarvis-never
the dataset delete 'Yes' (studio/Dataset.tsx) carries it and its 'No' does not
the Live Connector buttons approve, approveNew, accept and reject (studio/Connectors.tsx) carry it
tests.scope: Source-text check of specific buttons; the only test that ties a real control to Jarvis's refusal.

asserts: keepsSomething: Yes, OK, Okay, ஆம், ஆமாம், சரி, Save new version, Pin, Unpin, Add to dashboard, 'Add this chart to the dashboard (Environment page)' are keep buttons by name, text or both
Open, Show trends, Zone 13, Close panel are not; a long name cannot hide 'Pin' on the button
Thunai.tsx calls keepsSomething(t.name, t.el.textContent) and never tests KEEP_BUTTON on one joined string
tests.scope: Guard logic on strings, plus a source check of the call.

asserts: skeleton() folds invisible marks, fullwidth and Cyrillic/Greek look-alikes, leaves Tamil alone
the server drops a model's click on Verify, Accept, Close it, work is done, ஒப்புதல், நிராகரி and look-alike Send; isDangerButton('Reject') is true; Overview and Severe cases pass
tests.scope: The danger pattern shared by the client click guard and the server's plan check.

asserts: Thunai.tsx builds the click guard from the name and the text (keepsSomething(t.name, t.el.textContent))
the Data card's Yes (studio/DataCard.tsx) carries data-jarvis-never
'Yes ✓', 'Yes.', 'Yes!', 'ஆம்!', 'ஆமாம் ✓' are keep buttons
dashboard commands such as 'switch to weekly', 'open news', 'show only severe', 'turn on the rain layer', Tamil and Tanglish page moves run instantly from the rules (isPlainMove/isNavCommand)
questions ('Why are dengue cases rising in Teynampet?', 'how is Adyar doing this week') do not
tests.scope: Routing of console commands, not controls.

asserts: AI_ACTIONS never includes 'confirm': the model cannot send

gaps: No test enumerates the console's controls and checks that each has a Jarvis path or a deliberate refusal; this inventory is the first such list.

No test exercises thunai/dom.ts (clickables, byName, press, targetFor); targetFor has five stale selectors (.theme-t, [aria-label="Export report"], [aria-label="Workspaces"], [aria-label="Customize"], .sevtab).

Nothing checks that irreversible controls without a danger word carry data-jarvis-never: Sign out (account menu), Sign out every other device (Security), Run now/Refresh on Data sources (starts a pipeline load), Pause/Resume a source can all be pressed by a spoken 'click …'.
Nothing checks the reverse: harmless controls refused by a word (the chat's Send, Ask the Map's 'Remove <part>' chips, the workspace delete question's 'Keep').

jarvisReachLegend.step: a dedicated Jarvis step, Stage command, recipe or spoken flow does it (or does exactly its outcome)
jarvisReachLegend.partial: Jarvis reaches part of it, or an equivalent outcome by another route (see jarvisToday)
jarvisReachLegend.generic: only the generic 'click <name>' / 'show numbers' + 'click N' path (dom.ts), with its limits
jarvisReachLegend.blocked: deliberately refused: danger words, data-jarvis-never, keep words, password fields, or Jarvis's own UI with no spoken path
jarvisReachLegend.no: not reachable: <select> options, checkboxes, canvas/vector map marks, rows with onClick but no role, gestures, OS dialogs

findings: The item step ('open the third one') always counts the Overview's By severity list (Thunai.tsx:462-474), whatever window is open; the Incident list window's rows, sort headers and filters have no voice path at all (list.row.open, list.sort.*, list.* selects).

Every <select> (zone/taluk/department filters aside, which have steps) and every checkbox is unreachable: press() only focuses inputs (dom.ts:69-72). This covers the Environment station pickers, the list's Severity/Status/Time range, Customize's 13 boxes, Ask the Map's 14 layers, the Send jobs ticks, the chatbot's language.

On the Data Studio with a dataset open, every sentence that is not a page move or a reflex goes to the dataset engine (Thunai.tsx:1811-1819): filters, panels, 'click <name>', 'type' and 'scroll' do not reach the console there; only 'show numbers' + 'click N' does.
Rain & flooding has no step: it opens only when a rain question reaches Ask the Map (rehearsalIntent) or by a click; its 4 tabs, rain list, zones, streets and cards are generic clicks.
Jarvis's lang step changes only its own language; the site's English/Tamil switch is reached only by a generic click.
Unguarded write controls a spoken 'click …' would press: see writeControlsReachableByAnUnguardedGenericClick (notably Sign out, Sign out every other device, Data sources Run now/Refresh and Pause).
Harmless controls refused by a word in their name: the chatbot's Send, Ask the Map's 'Remove <part>' chips, the workspace delete question's 'Keep', a dataset focus chip's 'Remove'.
Five ghost-pointer selectors in dom.ts targetFor are stale (.theme-t, [aria-label="Export report"], [aria-label="Workspaces"], [aria-label="Customize"], .sevtab).

Jarvis's own UI (HUD, cards, tray, Stage, side panel, Earlier questions) is excluded from generic clicks; most of it has spoken commands, but the tray's Discard, the 'noticed something' card (Tell me / Later / Not about this), the queue badge and the brief card's Fold/Close have none.
